CONTROLLER'S AUDITS DIVISION 2 SCOPE AND METHODOLOGY The purpose of our audit was to investigate whether employees at the Bayview branch library were stealing money from the fines and other revenues they collected. To conduct this investigation, we assessed the cash handling procedures used by the Bayview branch library, the other branch libraries, and the main library. We visited the main library and each of the 26 branch libraries between January 1 1 and January 21, 1999, and counted all the cash the libraries had collected and still retained at the time of our visits.
